entries.summary: Restore expert manual CBM installation as an off-by-default world mod with meaningful surgical risk.
details: Positive-difficulty CBMs without dedicated procedures require electronics 8, health care 6, mechanics 4, surgical tools, sterile supplies, and anesthetic.
Improvised surgery causes pain and retains at least a five-percent failure chance with the existing dangerous consequences.

entries.summary: Shorten Rubik's restock and trust cadence while keeping tiered sales deterministic and gated.
details: Rubik restocks every three days and unlocks CBM tiers at Exodii trust 1, 8, 16, and 30.
Exodii installation has a lower service multiplier; other installers and ownership or trading costs remain unchanged.
